provider: 超星云盘 Chaoxing Cloud (pan-yz.chaoxing.com) + 超星小组盘

free_tier.stated: 100 GB free per account (was 150 GB before a reduction; one vendor page still advertises '为每个用户提供150G的初始容量空间'). Per-file: 1 GB on web, up to 15 GB via the desktop client ('客户端上传单文件上限15G').
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: Upload/download not speed-limited ('上传下载不限速'). Downloads of *shared* files require login. A read-gate on the sharing path, not the byte path.

tooling: OpenList driver `chaoxing` (超星小组盘. Group drive variant, explicitly '需要代理才能使用') and qaiu/netdisk-fast-download `pcx` with a mandatory `Referer: https://pan-yz.chaoxing.com`. Both are reverse-engineered.
chaining: Accounts provide 100 GB each, tied to institutional student identifiers (学号), with group drives (小组盘) adding shared pools per course.
limits_note: per-object-cap: 1 GB (web) / 15 GB (client). pull-count / write-gate: sharing requires the recipient to log in. No published API rate limit; parsers require a Referer header and CHAOXING marks the group drive as proxy-only.

identity_cost.detail: national-id (超星学习通 account, effectively student/real-name bound).

reliability_note: Quota was cut 150 GB → 100 GB, i.e. it moves downward. Interfaces are reverse-engineered and break when the university portal changes.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
